scenarios.name: red-noncombat-damage-below-power-raised-to-four
scenarios.why: A controlled red source would deal three noncombat damage to an opponent, less than Ojer's four power, so the modified amount is four.

scenarios.name: damage-to-controller-is-not-raised
scenarios.why: The recipient is not an opponent, so even a controlled red source's three noncombat damage remains three.
